snippet.title: Cash Dash Smash - Trailer
snippet.description: Cash Dash Smash is a fun casual arcade game with the task of cruising down a desert road collecting bundles of cash scattered on the road. The game includes eight 60s and 70s inspired vans to unlock, and each has its own objective of cash to collect. How many miles can you go? How much money can you collect before crashing? Quick reflexes are essential to win, but keep your eyes on the road as speed increases the farther you progress.
